title: Not Found
description: A 404 section composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Badge, Button and Skeleton primitives: the error code, a serif title, one line of description, a way home and a way to support, then a short list of popular pages, with its own empty, loading and error renders for that list; responds to its container (@container) — the actions move side by side at @sm, the title steps up at @md and the message and the list split into two columns at @lg.
